notes: v672 - the diary can now tell you the difference between 'your report card says nothing is proven' and 'the bot could not READ your report card'. Those look identical from outside and have completely different fixes. The bot only uses a graded card if three things match: the data day, the exchange, and the LIQUIDITY FLOOR it was graded at. If you change the floor after the card was graded, the bot quietly treats the card as unavailable - while My Rules can still show 'Now leading: ...' because that line falls back to a value cached from an earlier successful run. So the two screens disagreed, and neither said why. The diary now names exactly which of the three does not match and shows both values, or says plainly that no card is cached yet. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
